entries.source_line: [_Returning._] My lord, I would I might entreat your honour
entries.original_now: IAGO. My lord, I would I might entreat your honour To scan this thing no further. Leave it to time: Though it be fit that Cassio have his place, For sure he fills it up with great ability, Yet if you please to hold him off awhile, You shall by that perceive him and his means. Note if your lady strain his entertainment With any strong or vehement importunity, Much will be seen in that. In the meantime, Let me be thought too busy in my fears (As worthy cause I have to fear I am) And hold her free, I do beseech your honour.

entries.modern_now: IAGO. My lord, I wish I could beg your lordship not to dig into this any further. Leave it to time. Although it's right that Cassio gets his post back, since he certainly fills it with great ability, still, if you'd keep him at arm's length a while, you'll see from that what he's like and how he operates. Notice if your lady pushes hard for his reinstatement with any strong or passionate pleading; that will tell you a lot. In the meantime, let me be thought too meddlesome in my fears (as I have good reason to fear I am) and consider her innocent, I beg your lordship.

entries.source_line: In the due reverence of a sacred vow [_Kneels._]
entries.original_now: OTHELLO. Never, Iago. Like to the Pontic Sea, Whose icy current and compulsive course Ne’er feels retiring ebb, but keeps due on To the Propontic and the Hellespont; Even so my bloody thoughts, with violent pace Shall ne’er look back, ne’er ebb to humble love, Till that a capable and wide revenge Swallow them up. Now by yond marble heaven, In the due reverence of a sacred vow I here engage my words.

entries.modern_now: OTHELLO. Never, Iago. Like the Pontic Sea — the Black Sea — whose icy current and unstoppable flow never feels the tide pull back, but keeps rushing on into the Propontic and the Hellespont, just so my bloody thoughts, at their violent pace, will never look back, never ebb into gentle love, until a vast, all-consuming revenge swallows them up. Now, by that marble sky up there, with the proper reverence of a sacred vow I here pledge my word.

entries.source_line: Do not rise yet. [_Kneels._]
entries.original_now: IAGO. Do not rise yet. Witness, you ever-burning lights above, You elements that clip us round about, Witness that here Iago doth give up The execution of his wit, hands, heart, To wrong’d Othello’s service! Let him command, And to obey shall be in me remorse, What bloody business ever.

entries.source_line: [_To Iago._] O Spartan dog,
entries.original_now: LODOVICO. O Spartan dog, More fell than anguish, hunger, or the sea, Look on the tragic loading of this bed. This is thy work. The object poisons sight, Let it be hid. Gratiano, keep the house, And seize upon the fortunes of the Moor, For they succeed on you. To you, lord governor, Remains the censure of this hellish villain. The object poisons sight, Let it be hid. Gratiano, keep the house, And seize upon the fortunes of the Moor, For they succeed on you. To you, lord governor, Remains the censure of this hellish villain. The time, the place, the torture, O, enforce it! Myself will straight aboard, and to the state This heavy act with heavy heart relate.
entries.modern_now: LODOVICO. Oh, you Spartan dog, savage and silent, more deadly than pain, hunger, or the sea, look at the tragic load on this bed. This is your work. The sight poisons the eyes; cover it up. Gratiano, take charge of the house and take possession of the Moor's property, because it passes on to you as heir. To you, lord governor, falls the sentencing of this hellish villain: the time, the place, the torture — oh, make sure it's carried out! I'll go on board ship right away, and with a heavy heart report this heavy deed to the state.
